parts:

I am new to histograms in general and I am finding it hard NOT to have the COUNTs on the y-axis, but having the life expectancy (df$Value) instead.

Sorry for the very dumb question but I couldn’t find much to help me online.

Bests,

Ale

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: histogram
parts:
Thanks for providing a simple reproducible example!

I'm a little confused what you want to do; histograms, by definition,
have counts on the y axis. Do you want to graph the data using a bar
graph? Then e.g.:

ggplot(df, aes(GEO, Value)) + geom_bar(stat='identity') +
theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90))

If not, maybe specify a little more what you're hoping to achieve.

Ben
